title: L.A. Warehouse Fire Leaves Behind Rats, Flies and an Unending Stench
summary: The Boyle Heights neighborhood of Los Angeles is still dealing with the smell of rotting food and fears over possible toxins after a cold-storage facility burst into flames in June.
